game_concept: A puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Summit Spire, the highest spire: the mountaineer must handle storm winds while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Key Vault: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the supply cache.
theme: Frost Peaks – Summit Spire: the highest spire
core_gameplay_loop: In Summit Spire, repeat each round: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the supply cache. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the vault_keys value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the supply cache using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The supply cache reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the supply cache is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 3 (intro tier): Key Vault
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Key Vault' (Week 8 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Summit Spire'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault_keys changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm winds in Summit Spire.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The supply cache reached with actions_used <= 19.
